problem_statement: Build a brand-new /events page from scratch for the ACADEMIA online-education site (Create React App + react-scripts 5 + react-router-dom v5). The /events route does not exist yet (it currently renders empty). Create it as a routed page reachable at /events, registered inside the existing <Switch> in src/App.js so the shared Header (ACADEMIA logo + nav) and Footer chrome render around it exactly like every other page. Reuse the site's existing design system: the #1eb2a6 teal accent, the shared Back page-banner (title 'Campus Events'), the shared Heading component (subtitle 'EVENTS' + title 'Upcoming Events'), the .container wrapper, the .shadow card surface, and the Roboto font. The page presents upcoming campus events as a category-filtered, data-driven list: three category tab buttons (Workshops / Seminars / Bootcamps) and a responsive grid of event cards. Only the selected category's events are shown; Workshops is selected on first load. Clicking a category tab switches the visible events to that category (a real client-side filter). Each event card is an h3 title, a Workshop/Seminar/Bootcamp badge, date + location meta, a short description, and a seats note. The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow at a 390px mobile viewport, and must reuse the same Header nav links and Footer sections as the rest of the site (cross-page consistency).
required_content: Shared Back banner with the page title 'Campus Events' as an h1
Shared Heading block: subtitle 'EVENTS' and title 'Upcoming Events' (h1)
A short intro paragraph starting 'Browse our upcoming ...'
Workshops category selected by default; its event cards visible on first load (e.g. 'React Fundamentals Workshop' as an h3)
Clicking the 'Seminars' tab filters the list to seminar events (e.g. 'AI Research Seminar' as an h3) and hides the workshop cards
Each event card reuses the site's .shadow surface and #1eb2a6 accent, with an h3 title, a category badge, date/location meta and a seats note
Shared Header nav (Home / All Courses / About / Team / Pricing / Journal / Contact) and Footer (Explore / Quick Links) render around the page, identical to other routes
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow on mobile (390px)
design_constraints: Register the route inside the existing <Switch> in src/App.js so Header + Footer chrome wrap the page
Reuse #1eb2a6 teal accent, .container / .shadow / .flex globals from src/App.css, and the shared Back + Heading common components
Roboto font inherited from App.css; no new font fetch
Namespace new page classes (ev-*) to avoid inheriting other pages' global CSS widths
